{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Oh, what a way to cap it off for their first ace.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N首记{\fs78}ACE{\fs68} 精彩收下首盘！
